blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon – Ten-year-old Ray Mark woke up early with one thing in mind: survival. Located 15 kilometers from Valencia City’s economic hub, the Tongan Tongan Elementary School student joined thousands of “terrified yet prepared citizens across the nation.” They dove under desks for the life-saving “duck, cover, and hold” routine as the Fourth Quarter Nationwide Simultaneous Earthquake Drill was held on Thursday morning, Nov. 5. “We must be ready in our own way when the ground trembles,” Ray Mark said in Cebuano, describing the tense moments spent following his teachers’ urgent instructions alongside his classmates.
